summary: Firefox added WebGL support for several graphics extensions, including `EXT_texture_mirror_clamp_to_edge`, `EXT_clip_control` and `EXT_polygon_offset_clamp`, giving web graphics more control over texture edges, coordinate handling and depth. It also improves Canvas performance and resource cleanup, including zero-copy transfer of Linux video frames into remote Canvas 2D, and avoids presenting OffscreenCanvas frames while a window is inactive.
